info.name: Netflix Clone API - Complete Local Suite v1
info.description: API-level smoke and CRUD suite for all six services. Folders run in order: Health -> Identity -> Profile -> Subscription -> Payment -> Catalog -> Streaming Seed -> Streaming -> Cleanup. All teardown is consolidated in 08 - Cleanup.

item.name: 00 - Health
item.description: Verify every service is reachable before running functional tests.

item.name: 01 - Identity
item.description: Register, login, verify current user, rotate refresh token. Token revocation deferred to 08 - Cleanup.

item.name: 02 - Profile

exec:
pm.test("Profile update succeeds (200)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.expect(pm.response.json().displayName).to.eql("Updated Postman Profile");

item.description: CRUD on user profiles. Delete deferred to 08 - Cleanup so profileId stays available for Streaming.

item.name: 03 - Subscription
item.description: List plans, create pending subscription, verify status. Cancellation deferred to 08 - Cleanup.

item.name: 04 - Payment

exec:
pm.test("Failed payment path is deterministic (201)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql("Failed");

item.description: Successful charge, history, single-payment lookup, deterministic failure, plan change. Cancellation deferred to 08 - Cleanup.

item.name: 05 - Catalog

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Postman Test Film",
  "description": "Created by the complete API suite",
  "genres": ["Drama", "Test"],
  "releaseYear": 2026,
  "maturityRating": "PG-13",
  "cast": ["Test Actor"],
  "durationMinutes": 120,
  "streamingAssetId": "postman-test-film.mp4"
}

exec:
pm.test("Title update succeeds (200)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.expect(pm.response.json().name).to.eql("Updated Postman Test Film");

item.description: CRUD on catalog titles. titleId is reused by Streaming Seed. Delete deferred to 08 - Cleanup.

item.name: 06 - Streaming Seed
item.description: Register a media asset via POST /api/v1/admin/media-assets using titleId from Catalog. Tests upsert semantics and 400 validation. Deregistration deferred to 08 - Cleanup.

item.name: 07 - Streaming
item.description: Playback endpoints: media lookup, position save/retrieve, and 404/400 edge cases. Requires streamingTitleId and profileId from earlier folders.

item.name: 08 - Cleanup

exec: pm.test("Second deregister is a no-op (204)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));

item.description: Tear down all resources in reverse-dependency order: media asset -> catalog title -> subscription -> profile -> refresh token.
